problem: The text says 'Since cc0.1≈1.1052<1.2', which is garbled and mathematically wrong. It does not state the correct inequality needed to justify M=1.2.

The statement 'It is zero only when f itself is a polynomial of degree at most n' is false. The remainder R_n(x) is zero at x=a for any function, and can be zero at other isolated points. The intended meaning is that the remainder is not identically zero.
fix: The remainder is not zero in general; it is identically zero only when f is a polynomial of degree at most n.

problem: Exponents are written without superscripts in several places, e.g. 'ex' for e^x, 'e0.1' for e^0.1, 'ec' for e^c, '(1+x)n' for (1+x)^n, '|x−a|n+1' for |x−a|^{n+1}, 'xn+1' for x^{n+1}. This is ambiguous on a phone screen.
fix: Use <sup> tags or Unicode superscripts: e<sup>x</sup>, e<sup>0.1</sup>, e<sup>c</sup>, (1+x)<sup>n</sup>, |x−a|<sup>n+1</sup>, x<sup>n+1</sup>.
